newsitem.title: USA: Salt River Project Ariz. coal units down for work.
newsitem.headline: Salt River Project Ariz. coal units down for work.

text.p: Salt River Project's (SRP) 350 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Coronado coal-fired power plant in eastern Arizona is expected to restart November 12 after being shut October 26 for maintenance, a company spokesman said Monday.
The Coronado plant also has a second 350 MW unit.
Another regular maintenance outage is scheduled to start Saturday at SRP's Navajo coal-fired unit 1, located in Page, Ariz.
The 720 MW unit is scheduled to be out of service until December 18. The Navajo plant has two other 720 MW units.

SRP, a state government agency, is the owner and operator of Coronado. It holds a 27 percent interest in the Navajo plant, which is also owned by the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation and various public power companies.
